Platinum Living Dex

All 493 National Dex entries with one way to get each in Pokémon Platinum, in your order of preference: catch it wild, then evolve, then breed. When Platinum can't do it, the entry says which other game to get it from and where. Each catch shows how many copies you need and what they evolve or breed into. Each game keeps its own progress.

Tick the Poké Ball when it's in your boxes.

Locations come from each game's own data (the pret/pokeplatinum, pret/pokediamond and pret/pokeheartgold projects), cross-checked against Serebii. Trade locations come from the same kind of data for the other Gen 4 games, Emerald, FireRed/LeafGreen and Ruby/Sapphire. Black/White and Black 2/White 2 data comes from PokéAPI. Each game's full source list is under Sources at the top. Gold/Silver/Crystal and Red/Blue/Yellow trade Kanto Pokémon both ways through the Time Capsule. Gen 4 Pokémon reach the Gen 5 games through Poké Transfer (Route 15, after the National Dex), and GBA Pokémon go through Pal Park first. HeartGold/SoulSilver Pokéwalker routes aren't included. DS games trade over with a second DS. GBA games move Pokémon over with Pal Park (a DS or DS Lite with a GBA slot, after you have the National Dex). Trade evolutions need a second DS game to trade to and back. Levels are the wild range. A Breed entry shows how to catch its parent until you've ticked that parent, then switches to Breed. Odds are the chance that a wild encounter at that spot is this Pokémon (Poké Radar odds are per shake of the grass). Filters combine: pick several and you'll see every Pokémon that fits any of them.
